moa: humanized monoclonal antibody that inhibits complement component C1s (classical pathway)

approval_evidence.quote: BLA 761164 BLA APPROVAL ... for Enjaymo (sutimlimab-jome) injection. ... Enjaymo is indicated to decrease the need for red blood cell (RBC) transfusion due to hemolysis in adults with cold agglutinin disease (CAD).

series_start_reason: First quarter with a printed Enjaymo row: Sanofi's Q2 2022 release prints 3 (Q2) and 4 (first half). The Q1 2022 release (accession 0001121404-22-000009) prints no Enjaymo sales row; the first-half figure implies about EUR 1 million in Q1 but that is a difference of rounded figures and is not used. The FDA approval was in February 2022; no issuer document located dates a first sale.
notes: Worldwide Enjaymo in-market sales in EUR: Sanofi's net sales line 2022Q2-2024Q3, then Recordati's Enjaymo net revenue line 2025Q1-2026Q2 (Recordati closed the acquisition of the global rights on November 29, 2024; both lines are worldwide and in EUR). 2024Q4 is an ownership-gap quarter and has no row. Recordati's quarters are read from its own releases: 2025Q1 and 2026Q1 are printed as the quarter; 2025Q2 (first half less Q1), 2025Q3 (nine months less first half), 2025Q4 (full year less nine months) and 2026Q2 (first half less Q1) are derived from year-to-date figures. 2025 figures are in EUR millions to one decimal and 2026 figures are printed in EUR thousands. 2023 full year sums to the printed 72, 2024Q1-Q3 sum to the nine-month figure 83, and the four 2025 quarters sum to the printed full year 146.3. Recordati's line is its net revenue from Enjaymo and Sanofi's is net sales; the sources do not describe any difference in what they include.

unreported_quarters.2024Q4: Sanofi booked in-market sales only until November 29, 2024 (EUR 22 million printed for the part quarter in its Q4 2024 release, accession 0001121404-25-000002, left out as a part-quarter). Recordati's FY 2024 preliminary release prints only Enjaymo sales in December 2024 of EUR 10.9 million, a one-month figure; no document prints a full-quarter figure, and splicing the two issuers' part-quarters is not done.
